capabilities: Create, edit and complete tasks as Markdown checklist lines
Toggle task status between Todo, In Progress and Done
Reschedule unfinished tasks from previous days to today
Archive completed tasks into monthly files in a simple-todo directory
Organize tasks under date headings (YYYY-MM-DD Weekday)
extras: README is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese) and includes a development guide; future features like priority management are listed as pending todo items.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in workflow for managing a running todo list with status tracking, carrying unfinished tasks forward, and archiving completed ones.
summary: Text-based GTD task manager that stores todos as Markdown checklist lines organized under date headings, with toggling, rescheduling and archiving.
